ns2:course.label: Senior Design II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of BIOE 435. Design teams finalize concepts, evaluate alternatives, model and analyze solutions, build and test a final product, and present the results professionally to project sponsors. 2 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: BIOE 435.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 2 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: BIOE 435.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Bioengineering department.
